detection: artifact count rises without reproducibility, utility, external use, or conversion evidence
correction: route candidates through evidence, duplication, maintenance, IP, and offer-readiness gates

failure: GitHub Sponsors approval mistaken for sponsorship received
detection: profile status changes but no real sponsor transaction exists
correction: record revenue only from an observed provider transaction

detection: views, clones, or stars increase without qualified use, retention, sponsorship, or payment
correction: report funnel stages separately and require downstream evidence

detection: delivery cost consumes excessive tier revenue or promises unlimited work
correction: bound benefits, estimate maintenance, separate custom services

detection: banking, tax-ID, address, or credential field enters repository artifacts
correction: fail closed, purge safely, rotate affected credentials when relevant, keep provider data in authorized interfaces

failure: score mistaken for truth or valuation
detection: internal heuristic cited as scientific probability, company value, income forecast, or product-market fit
correction: label score as a routing heuristic and require external evidence

detection: patent candidate or trade secret marked public
correction: block publication until explicit IPGate decision

detection: support, compute, API, security, or documentation cost is greater than net receipts
correction: revise pricing/scope, automate safely, merge products, pause, or stop
